title: Why Adult Beginners Quit Piano in the First Three Months
summary: Almost nobody stops because they lack talent. They stop for four ordinary reasons, and every one of them can be designed out in advance.

title: Practising Piano When You Have a Job, a Family and Twenty Minutes
summary: The commonest reason adults stop is not difficulty. It is time. So here is precisely what I would put in your twenty minutes, and what I would cut first.

title: What European Music Schools Teach Children That American Adults Were Never Taught
summary: Ear before eye, voice before hands, and naming what you hear. Three ordinary parts of a European childhood in music that most American adults were simply never offered.
